en.a: UC SmartPick plans courses around your life goal: pick grad school or employment first, then choose courses against degree requirements, auto-schedule prereq chains, and assess graduation-timeline pressure.
Three steps on Home: pick a goal (grad/job) → campus and major → check courses on the Major tab → auto-schedule on the Plan tab.
Tap the blue AP badge next to a course: it shows which AP exam, what score, and which UC course it covers. Data from official AP charts.
Tap the green CC badge: it shows which CC course articulates. Data from official ASSIST mappings. No badge means 'not in our library', not 'no equivalent'.
Some courses require another first (e.g. MATH 20B needs 20A). The scheduler puts prereqs earlier automatically; the longest chain sets the minimum quarters you need.
Deterministic engine: topological layers by prereqs, each course placed in the earliest term where prereqs are met and your unit cap holds. Missing prereqs are assumed done, with a warning.
1 unit ≈ 3 study hrs/week. 168 − 56 sleep − study = free hours. It's an estimate; the formula is shown on the page so you can verify.
Pick 2 years on the Plan tab: it computes the prereq-chain minimum, units per term, and weekly hours. Chains can't compress — missing units must come from AP/CC before enrollment.
Pick a second major on Home; the Major tab gains three views: primary, second, overlap. Overlap courses count twice — schedule them first.
en.q: How do I plan a double major?

en.a: Your 4-year plan laid over time, each course annotated with why you picked it (which requirement, grad/job relevance). Copy or download it — ready material for essays, cold emails, resumes.
Marks courses you've done or covered via AP/CC. They grey out, count toward requirement progress, and are skipped by scheduling.
UCI, UCSD and UCSB official catalogs; major requirements from the official catalogs (checked Oct 2026). Always confirm with the official source — this is planning reference.
en.q: Where is the data from? Is it accurate?

en.a: UCI, UCSD and UCSB course data is live. UCLA and UCB pipelines are in progress.
Only in this device's browser — never uploaded. Switching devices or clearing cache loses it; export from Trajectory to back up.
No — we have no quarterly schedule data, so no live enrollment status. Prereq chains and degree planning are our strength; enroll on the official site.
en.q: Can I see if a class is full?

en.a: The official catalog doesn't list any, or we haven't parsed it yet. They're treated as having no prereqs.
en.q: Why do some courses lack prereq info?

en.a: Heuristic only: 199 = research credit, 200+ = graduate level, project/design in title = project course. Not official.
Enter leave quarters in the Plan timeline; they're subtracted from available terms before pace is computed.
Check '+ summer' in the timeline to add one quarter per year — 2-year graduation usually needs summer.
Use the feedback link by the 💬 button to file a GitHub issue — the developer will see it.

en.q: How do transfer students import credits?
en.a: On the home page tap "I'm a transfer student" → pick your campus and community college → check the courses you took → import. Matching UC courses are marked completed and your major progress updates. Data from ASSIST articulation.

zh-CN.a: UC 智选帮你按人生目标选课：先定读研/就业目标，再按毕业要求挑课，自动排先修顺序，还能评估几年毕业的压力。
首页三步：选目标（读研/就业）→ 选校区和专业 → 去专业页勾课加入清单 → 排课页一键排课。
专业页课程旁的蓝色AP徽标点开看：哪门AP考试、考几分、抵哪门UC课。数据来自学校官方AP对照表。
绿色CC徽标点开看：哪所社区大学的哪门课能等效。数据来自ASSIST官方映射。注意：只显示库里有的，没有徽标不代表没有等效课。
有些课必须先修完另一门才能上，比如MATH 20B要求先修20A。排课引擎会自动把先修课排在前面，压不扁的链条决定了你最少要读几个quarter。
确定性算法：按先修拓扑分层，每门课放进先修已满足、且学分没超你设的上限的最早学期。不在清单里的先修课视为已修完并会提醒你。
1学分≈每周3小时学习。168小时−睡56−学习=可支配时间。这是估算，公式公开写在页面上，你可以自己验算。
zh-CN.q: 时间线评估里的压力值怎么算的？

zh-CN.a: 排课页选2年会算：先修链最少要几个quarter、每学期要修几学分、每周几小时。链条压不扁，缺的学分得靠入学前AP/CC带够。
首页第二专业选一个，专业页会出现三个切页：主专业、第二专业、重叠课程。重叠课一门顶两门，优先排。一键加入会把两个专业必修并起来。
把你的四年计划按时间排开，每门课标注为什么选它（满足哪条毕业要求、跟读博/就业的关系），可复制导出——写文书、套辞、简历时直接用。
标记你已经修过或用AP/CC抵掉的课。它会变灰、计入毕业要求进度，排课和一键加入时自动跳过。
UCI、UCSD和UCSB官方课程目录，专业要求来自官方目录（2026年10月核对）。课程变动以学校官方为准，APP只做规划参考。
zh-CN.q: 课程数据哪里来的？准吗？

zh-CN.a: 目前UCI、UCSD和UCSB课程数据已入库。UCLA、UCB数据管线进行中。
只存在你这台设备的浏览器本地，不上传。换设备或清缓存会丢，重要规划建议用轨迹页导出备份。
不能。我们没有季度开课表数据，做不到实时选课状态。先修链和毕业规划是我们的强项，抢课去学校官网。
官方目录里就没写，或我们还没解析到。不影响使用：排课时当它无先修处理。
zh-CN.q: 为什么有的课没有先修信息？

zh-CN.a: 启发式标注，仅供参考：199号是科研学分课，200+是研究生级，标题带project/design的是项目课。别当官方认定。
zh-CN.q: 目标标签（读博信号这些）准吗？

zh-CN.a: 排课页时间线里填休学几个quarter，会直接从可用学期数里扣掉，再算每学期负荷。
排课页时间线勾选“含暑期”，每年多算一个quarter，2年毕业基本要靠暑期。
点右下角💬旁边的反馈，直接去GitHub提issue，开发者会看到。

zh-CN.q: 转学生怎么用？转学分怎么导入？
zh-CN.a: 首页点「我是转学生」→选校区和你转出的社区大学→勾选修过的课→一键导入，专业页会自动把对应的 UC 课标为已修，进度直接更新。数据来自 ASSIST 转学分映射。
可以先去 TransferOS-China 规划 CC 选课和转学路径，拿到录取后再回 UC 智选用转学分导入，入学后的选课排课都在这边。
